title: A Reality Check of Inference-Time Context Augmentation Methods
abstract: arXiv:2610.30983v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) often fail to utilise the context given in the input, resulting in hallucinations or a fallback to parametric knowledge. Context augmentation methods aim to improve model performance by modifying the input, from inserting filler tokens that add computational time to adding relevant content such as elaboration of a context during inference. However, these methods have been evaluated in isolation and only by their performance gains, leaving it unclear how they compare and whether they reliably improve performance. In this paper, we present an evaluation framework spanning five methods that differ in how informative the inserted content is and apply them at the sentence level across seven models spanning multiple sizes on three datasets. translated_title: 推理时上下文增强方法的现实检验
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）常常无法利用输入中给出的上下文，从而导致幻觉或退回到参数化知识。上下文增强方法旨在通过修改输入来提升模型性能，从插入会增加计算时间的填充词元，到在推理过程中添加相关内容（如对上下文的详细阐述）。然而，这些方法此前都是在孤立场景下评估的，且仅依据其性能提升来衡量，这使得它们之间的比较尚不清晰，也无法确定它们是否能可靠地提升性能。在本文中，我们提出了一个评估框架，涵盖五种在所插入内容信息量上各不相同的方法，并将它们在句子层面应用于三个数据集上的七个不同规模的模型。我们发现，准确率的提升并不总是真正的改进，而是一种无方向的扰动：这些方法在纠正某些预测的同时也破坏了其他预测，尤其当插入的内容……
tldr: 该论文提出了一个涵盖五种上下文增强方法、七个不同规模模型和三个数据集的统一评估框架，并发现推理时上下文增强带来的准确率提升并非总是真正的改进，而是无方向的扰动——这些方法在纠正部分预测的同时也会破坏其他预测。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a unified evaluation framework spanning five context augmentation methods, seven models of various sizes, and three datasets, finding that accuracy gains from inference-time context augmentation are not always genuine improvements but undirected perturbations—correcting some predictions while breaking others.
